title: Debug D.U.D.E.A.D.
subject: Code
description: The robot drives in circles. Find out why before the Faire.

quiz.prompt: The sensor returns 0 every few readings. What does that usually mean?
choices: The sensor is broken and needs replacing
A loose connection — an intermittent fault
quiz.explain: A dead sensor returns 0 every time. Intermittent zeros point at a connection that's making contact only sometimes.

quiz.prompt: What should you always do before changing any code?
choices: Replace the part you think is broken
Look at what's actually happening, with the Serial Monitor
quiz.explain: An engineer's first question is never "what should I change?" It's "what is actually happening?"
